decisions.reason: The 15-day program is cheap to maintain and close to the core, but after the 72-hour program was dropped it overlaps with express line D, so consolidation remains a real possibility without a clear shortfall forcing it now.
The multi-model express line has its own page and anchors the firm's fast-delivery positioning, and there is no evidence of performance below aspiration that would trigger problemistic search.
The online ordering and digital services platform supports the strategic move toward service and advisory depth, and the large firm's slack allows it to carry the platform while its returns mature.
The fire and smoke protection door is a compliance-driven core product with steady demand in a growing industry, and it is unlikely to fall short of aspirations.
